title: Retrospective Analysis of the Safety and Efficacy of Hydroxychloroquine in Immune Thrombocytopenia
brief_summary: Retrospective study of the safety and efficacy of hydroxychloroquine among patients with immune Thrombopenia (ITP).
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients older than 18 years old
* Immune Thrombopenia according to the American Society of Hematology (ASH) guidelines 2011
* Positive antinuclear antibodies \> 1/160e on Hep2 cells

Exclusion Criteria:

* Secondary ITP (eg HIV, HCV, HBV, lymphoproliferative disorders...)
study_population: 40 patients with an immune thrombopenia with or without a definite SLE have been retrospectively studied. All the patients should have an ITP according to the ASH guidelines 2011 and have positive antinuclear antibodies (title \>1/160e on Hep2 cells).
